issues.location: forward De Bruijn translation context lookup
issues.finding: The source calls Gamma(x) the position of x in Gamma, but the context can contain repeated names after prepending a binder. Without first-occurrence lookup, the translation of a shadowed variable is ambiguous.
issues.proposed_resolution: Clarify in target prose that Gamma(x) uses the first occurrence of x in the zero-indexed context; retain all formal equations and source bytes.

issues.location: inverse De Bruijn translation context lookup
issues.finding: The inverse equation G_Gamma(n)=Gamma[n] is only defined when the requested index names an existing position in the context, but the prose omits this domain condition.
issues.proposed_resolution: State the in-context position condition in target prose; retain the partial equation and source bytes.

translation_treatment: Both domain clarifications are expressed in Javanese prose without changing mathematical spans or protected commands. The earlier OLP-0362 proof gap remains a separate open reader-release issue.
